mechanism: Ethinyl estradiol may increase escitalopram levels through inhibition of CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, and oral contraceptives can potentiate serotonergic effects while increasing bleeding risk through platelet aggregation inhibition.
action: Monitor for increased escitalopram side effects (nausea, tremor, hyponatremia); consider dose adjustment if adverse effects emerge; counsel on bleeding precautions and maintain consistent OCP use.
